tasks.commitBody:
The roster's indent/unindent controls were 12px mirror triangles
in muted ink — the reverse move existed but could not be found or
tapped (Joosep's report; the write-integrity half of his complaint
was #253, fixed first so that a still-broken write would not be
made easier to reach — this findability fix deliberately landed
last in the batch).

Both controls now meet the app's own touch-target standard, in the
app's normal control tone rather than the row-metadata muted ink.
An inapplicable direction no longer sits at opacity-30 pretending
to be tappable: it yields its interactivity but holds its space,
so rows do not jump as applicability changes. The two directions
are distinguishable at a glance rather than being mirror images of
the same small glyph; the mechanism and its reasoning are stated
in the review record.

Deliberately untouched, per the issue's own fences: the keyboard
path (row-grab + Space/Enter + ArrowLeft/Right, tabindex=-1 per
Mihkel's ruling — its spec pins pass unmodified), the
structuralWritePending one-write-at-a-time guard, the
canIndent/canUnindent applicability logic, section nesting itself,
and everything #253 fixed beneath these buttons.

Live gate (Joosep): open the roster arrange view on the phone —
both directions are visible, tappable at thumb size, and
tellable apart; a direction that does not apply neither invites a
tap nor shifts the row when it disappears.
